statement: At the pinned revision, Codex assembles selected skills and plugins into turn context and runs typed lifecycle hooks around session start, tool use, permissions, stop, compaction, and session end.

display_text.zh-CN: 在固定版本中，Codex 会把选中的 skills 与 plugins 组装进 turn context，并在 session start、tool use、permission、stop、compaction 和 session end 周围运行类型化 hooks。
display_text.en: At the pinned revision, Codex assembles selected skills and plugins into turn context and runs typed lifecycle hooks around session start, tool use, permissions, stop, compaction, and session end.

evidence.title: Codex turn-time skill and plugin assembly
